_source.title: 移除指示标记
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口会移除所有已生成的指示标记
_source.params.tabId: 标签页 ID，如若未传入，则为最后输入焦点的画布
_source.returns: 指示标记移除是否成功，`false` 表示画布不支持该操作或 `tabId` 不存在

title: Remove indicator markers
remarks.text.0: This API will remove all generated indicator markers
params.tabId: Tab ID. If not passed in, the canvas with the last input focus will be used
returns: Whether the indicator markers were removed successfully, `false` indicates that the canvas does not support this operation or `tabId` does not exist
